heading: CONVENIENCE OR DISCOVERY: WHICH MISSION WILL YOUR STORE SERVE? (12 MINUTE READ)
blurb: AI is splitting physical retail into two distinct missions. Convenience stores should reduce friction with easy navigation and reactive service. Discovery stores should drive dwell time through immersive experiences and specialized associates. More than 90% of consumers prioritize locations that fit their daily routines, while 78% cite product testing and 76% cite product guidance as drivers of discovery visits.
